question: I'm a CS senior with a Biological Sciences minor. I want to take a graduate-level bioinformatics course (03-511 or 03-512). Would a graduate bioinformatics course count toward my Biological Sciences minor requirements, or only as a free elective?
expected_answer: This depends on the specific Biological Sciences minor requirements and whether graduate-level courses are permitted. In general, undergraduate minors at CMU are designed around undergraduate courses. A graduate course may count as a free elective toward the overall unit requirement but may not satisfy a specific minor course requirement without explicit faculty/department approval. P-008 should consult the BS department and their advisor before relying on this substitution.
reasoning_type: Graduate vs. undergraduate course equivalence for minor requirements
common_mistake: Assuming graduate courses automatically satisfy undergraduate minor requirements; not knowing that most minors require approval for graduate course substitutions
needs_verification: Confirm the Biological Sciences minor requirements and whether graduate courses are explicitly excluded or included
Confirm whether 03-511 or 03-512 are listed as acceptable courses for the BS minor
Confirm that P-008 meets the prerequisites for 03-511 or 03-512 (graduate bioinformatics)
Confirm the approval process for counting graduate courses toward undergraduate minors at CMU-Q
